purpose: Diagnostic literature-informed audit; historical holdout already inspected, not independent confirmatory study
inner_groups: first six sorted original fit groups train, last two internal validation
method: Full-state affine residual with delay: state [z, z-z_previous], baseline z+last_increment, learn residual acceleration. Block RMS scaling invertible, no PCA.
selection: mean normalized one-step squared error on internal validation groups and calibration origins only; tie larger ridge; no final holdout tuning
